preconditions.description: The number of gifts n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each gift's pleasantness a[i] must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, and each edge must connect two distinct gifts within the valid range.

postconditions.description: If there are fewer than 2 gifts, output 'Impossible'.
If it is possible to choose gifts, output the maximum sum of pleasantness.
